method: Independently read all11 exact head/POS/Chinese/aliases/EN/ZH tuples; checked sense boundaries against actual measured misses and accepted only explicit transport/payment roles. Original lexical examples, no promises about service outcomes.

decisions.reason: Refund receipt is not a standby ticket; no guaranteed entitlement or amount is stated.
Only explicit bus aliases are accepted; general车 could also mean train and is not forced to this sense.
Two numbered senses distinguish travelling en route and a location on that route; the post-office example demonstrates the second.
Fee-free modifies the specified service fee; it is not a promise that every exchange spread or other cost disappears.
Payee-presented receiving code is explicitly distinguished from a payer-presented payment code; original shop-stall example is aligned.
A payment did not complete successfully, without inferring a cause or asserting a reversal occurred.
Payment reference is attached information used to identify a payment; it need not be an automatically generated bank transaction ID.

decisions.term: transfer money to the wrong account
decisions.reason: Money went to the unintended account; the example adds no refund or recovery guarantee.
Temporary card transaction restriction, distinct from freezing the entire bank account; independently checked Lloyds terminology.
An itemized bill lists individual charges; room-and-meals original example clearly demonstrates the noun phrase.
Submit the previously missing work; no inference of lateness or an approved deadline extension, distinct from C late assignment row.
